title: 第6章天牢夜审旧罪栽赃第7章侯府夜行私掘卷宗
content_zh:
天启十八年，秋。
夜色如浓稠的墨漆，彻底吞没了京都的繁华。寻常街巷早已灯火尽熄，唯有皇城北侧的天牢方向，常年悬着一盏盏昏黄孤灯，在萧瑟秋风里摇摇晃晃，映得整片禁地都浸在刺骨的阴寒之中。这里是大胤王朝最森严的囚狱，高墙三丈、铁锁千层，青砖石壁常年浸润在湿冷水汽里，生满墨绿青苔，地面缝隙积着经年不散的暗色血渍。世人皆言，入得天牢者，多半再无重见天日之机，这里从不缺冤魂，更不缺藏在律法之下的阴私构陷。
子夜三刻，万籁俱寂，唯有天牢深处不时传来铁链拖拽地面的刺耳声响，混着狱卒低沉的呵斥，在空旷的石廊间往复回荡。沉重的玄铁牢门被缓缓推开，铁锈摩擦的吱呀声撕裂死寂，几道身着玄色劲装、面覆银纹面具的人影，踏着冰冷夜色缓步走入。他们衣袂绣着暗纹暗影，周身气息冷冽肃杀，正是江湖中最神秘、也最令人闻风丧胆的暗影盟死士。
被他们押在正中的男子，名为铁寻柳。
此刻的铁寻柳，早已没了往日江湖游侠的飒然风骨。他双手被粗重的玄铁镣铐紧锁，腕间皮肉被冰冷铁箍磨得溃烂渗血，暗红血迹顺着小臂蜿蜒而下，滴落在冰冷的青石板上，晕开点点血花。双腿亦缚着沉重铁链，每走一步都要拖拽出刺耳声响，沉重的枷锁几乎要压弯他的脊背。他一袭素色布衣早已被尘土、血污浸染得脏乱不堪，发丝凌乱垂落，遮住了眉眼，唯有紧绷的下颌线条，透着不曾折损的傲骨。
无人知晓，这位素来行侠仗义、游走江湖、从不涉朝堂纷争的江湖客，今夜会被凭空拽入这场滔天祸局。无人知晓，这一场天牢囚困、深夜审讯，从始至终都是一场精心策划的栽赃死局。
半个时辰前，南城旧巷还灯火零星。铁寻柳本是应故人之约，前往巷中旧宅取回一件早年寄存的旧物。他半生磊落，行事光明，素来不屑朝堂权谋，不涉江湖纷争，只凭本心行走世间，扶弱济贫，却也正因这份闲散不羁、无门无派的性子，成了朝堂势力与暗影盟博弈中最完美的替罪羔羊。
暗影盟蛰伏朝堂暗处多年，暗中培植势力、勾结奸佞，近日因多年前一桩私通敌国、截杀边关密使的旧案险些败露。当年那场惨案牵连甚广，十余名边关密使尽数殒命，密报尽数失窃，朝堂追查数年毫无头绪，早已成悬案。为掩盖核心之人的罪证，暗影盟高层连夜定计，要寻一个无依无靠、人脉单薄、且曾短暂出现在案发地界的江湖人顶下所有罪责。
数年前，铁寻柳恰好途经案发边境小城，停留过半日。这般微不足道的过往，本是寻常行路踪迹，却被暗影盟刻意揪出、无限放大，成了栽赃他的唯一凭据。
旧巷之中，百余暗影盟死士骤然围堵，出手便是杀招，全然不留余地。铁寻柳虽身手卓绝，一柄长剑纵横江湖罕逢敌手，可对方人多势众、招式阴毒，且个个悍不畏死，缠斗百招之后，他不慎被独门迷烟暗算，经脉滞涩、内力溃散，最终寡不敌众，被生生制服。没有官差缉拿的文书，没有当庭指控的罪名，甚至没有一句公开罪责，他便被暗影盟以密令拘押，悄无声息送入这天牢禁地。
天牢之内，寒气刺骨，远比深秋夜风更甚。空气中常年弥漫着血腥、霉腐与铁锈交织的刺鼻气味，沉沉浊气笼罩四野，让人呼吸都觉滞涩压抑。两侧牢房层层叠叠、幽深无尽，铁栏锈蚀斑驳，牢内漆黑一片，隐隐能听见囚徒低低的呜咽、铁链晃动的轻响，偶有老鼠窜过地面的细碎声响，更加阴森恐怖。石壁缝隙不断渗出冰凉水汽，顺着墙面缓缓滴落，砸在青石板上，发出单调死寂的滴答声，声声叩人心弦。
暗影盟死士步履整齐，沉默无言，只凭手势交替引路，将铁寻柳一路拖拽至天牢最深处的密审刑房。这里是天牢禁地中的禁地，不属常规狱审之地，不受大理寺、刑部规制，专供秘审重犯、暗结冤狱，无数无人知晓的冤案，皆在此悄然落幕。
刑房正中立着一根漆黑刑柱，柱身布满深浅不一的旧痕，皆是历年审讯留下的血印与划痕。地面铺着厚重青石，早已被无数血水浸透，沉淀出洗不去的暗沉黑红。房内只点着两根粗大牛油巨烛，烛火昏黄摇曳，火光忽明忽暗，将人影拉扯得扭曲狭长，投在斑驳石壁上，宛如鬼魅游走。风声穿过窗棂缝隙，簌簌作响，衬得整座刑房愈发死寂阴森。
铁寻柳被死士狠狠按跪在地，双膝重重磕在冰冷坚硬的青石之上，剧痛瞬间蔓延全身。玄铁镣铐被死死锁在刑柱卡扣之上，四肢彻底被固定，动弹不得。粗糙的铁链深深嵌入皮肉，原本溃烂的伤口被拉扯撕裂，温热的鲜血不断渗出，顺着铁链缓缓滴落，砸在地面积起小小的血洼，冰凉与剧痛交织，啃噬着他的筋骨。
他缓缓抬起头，凌乱发丝下的一双眼眸依旧清亮锐利，没有半分怯懦惶恐，唯有沉沉冷冽与不解。他半生坦荡，无愧天地，从未做过祸乱平民、伤天害理之事，从未触碰过朝堂权谋、边关秘事，无端被拘、莫名入罪，他绝不甘心。
“为何拘我？”铁寻柳的声音沙哑干涩，却字字铿锵，穿透刑房死寂，“我铁寻柳行走江湖，俯仰无愧，未犯国法，未害苍生，尔等无凭无据，私拘良人，就不怕触怒律法、引火烧身？”
无人应答。
立于刑房正中的暗影盟首领缓缓抬手，摘掉覆面银纹面具。那人面容清瘦冷峻，眉眼藏着阴鸷狠戾，正是暗影盟执掌暗刑、专司栽赃灭口的核心之人，沈寒舟。他素来手段狠绝、心思缜密，经他之手的冤案数不胜数，从无失手，更从无活口。
沈寒舟缓步踱步至铁寻柳身前，垂眸俯视着狼狈跪地、满身伤痕却傲骨未折的男子，唇角勾起一抹冰冷讥讽的弧度。他俯身，指尖轻轻拂过刑柱上干涸的血痕，语气平淡无波，却带着彻骨寒意：“无愧天地？铁寻柳，到了这天牢之中，最无用的便是无愧二字。”
他抬手轻挥，身后两名暗影死士立刻上前，将一叠泛黄陈旧的卷宗重重拍在旁侧审讯案几之上。卷宗封皮陈旧破损，边角磨损发白，落着早年的官印痕迹，看似规整严谨，内里却早已被人篡改替换，字字皆是精心伪造的罪证。

“天启十年，秋末，西境雁回隘。”沈寒舟背手而立，声音清冷低沉，在空旷刑房中缓缓回荡，“边关密使携军机要务过境，当夜全员遇袭，一十三名密使尽数殒命，朝廷绝密军情尽数失窃，边关布防险些崩坏，连累无数将士枉死。此案悬滞五年，朝野追查无果，今日，终于寻得真凶。”
铁寻柳瞳孔骤然一缩，心头骤沉。
雁回隘密使截杀案，他早有耳闻。当年此案震动朝野，先帝震怒，下令举国追查，奈何凶手踪迹全无，最终沦为悬案。他清楚记得，永安二十二年秋末，他确曾途经雁回隘，彼时只是恰逢秋雨，在隘外小镇暂住两日避雨，从未靠近边关军营，更从未接触过任何密使与军机要务。这般寻常行路过往，竟被硬生生安上杀人截密、通敌叛国的滔天罪名。
“一派胡言。”铁寻柳厉声驳斥，眼底寒芒乍现，“当年我途经雁回隘，只是路过避雨，全程安分守己，从未参与任何争斗，更未触碰军机密报。五年悬案，证据全无，凭什么凭空栽赃于我？”
沈寒舟闻言不怒反笑，笑意冰冷刺骨，不含半分温度。他抬手翻开案上卷宗，指尖划过伪造的笔录与证物清单，字字清晰，句句诛心：“凭空栽赃？铁寻柳，你未免太过天真。”
“其一，当年雁回隘所有出入人员名录之中，唯你身份不明、无官无籍、行踪自由，且恰在案发当日逗留隘内，时机完全吻合。”
“其二，现场遗留的打斗剑痕，经朝堂匠人比对，与你惯用的流云剑法路数高度契合，天下能使出此剑势者，寥寥无几。”
“其三，当年逃逸的敌国细作临终留讯，曾提及一名布衣剑客协助其截杀密使、盗取军情，身形风貌，与你完全一致。”
三条所谓罪证，层层递进、环环相扣，看似铁证如山、无可辩驳，实则条条皆是刻意伪造、刻意拼凑的假象。剑痕可以仿刻，供词可以捏造，身形风貌可以刻意描摹，所有痕迹都被暗影盟精心打磨，抹去一切破绽，只为将铁寻柳死死钉在罪人的位置上。
铁寻柳看着那叠精心伪造的卷宗，只觉心底寒意翻涌，彻骨冰凉。他终于彻底看清，这根本不是一场寻常审讯，而是一场早有预谋的灭口栽赃。暗影盟不愿自身旧罪败露，便选中他这个无门无派、无靠山、无羁绊的江湖人作为替死鬼，用一桩尘封五年的旧案，彻底将他拖入万劫不复的深渊。
“皆是伪造。”铁寻柳牙关紧咬，声音冷硬如铁，“流云剑法虽为我所习，江湖间效仿者甚多，不足为凭。敌国细作临终供词死无对证，纯属捏造。仅凭行踪巧合便定人死罪，这便是你们所谓的铁证？”
沈寒舟淡淡看着他挣扎辩驳，神色无半分波澜，眼底只有漠然与冷酷：“这天牢之中，我等所言，便是铁证。”
话音落下，他抬手重重拍下桌案，沉声道：“夜审开始。拒不招供，便以刑逼供。”
刑房之内，气氛骤然肃杀。两侧暗影死士即刻上前，搬来各式锈蚀刑具，铁夹、皮鞭、钉板、火烙整齐罗列，冰冷金属在昏黄烛火下泛着森森冷光，映照得整座刑房宛如人间炼狱。经年累积的血腥气扑面而来，呛得人几欲窒息。
第一鞭落下，厚重浸盐的皮鞭狠狠抽在铁寻柳脊背之上，布料瞬间撕裂，皮肉绽开，火辣辣的剧痛瞬间席卷全身。狰狞的血痕立刻浮现，猩红刺眼，鲜血顺着脊背肌理缓缓流淌，浸透衣衫。
剧痛刺骨，铁寻柳身躯猛地一颤，额角瞬间渗出细密冷汗，指节因用力紧握而泛白。可他始终咬紧牙关，未曾发出半分痛呼，挺直的脊背纵然被枷锁束缚、被皮鞭抽打，依旧不肯弯折半分。
“招否？”沈寒舟沉声质问，语气冰冷压迫。
铁寻柳抬眼，目光凌厉如刀，直视眼前阴狠之人，字字铿锵：“无罪可招！”
content_en:
Autumn, the eighteenth year of the Apocalypse.
The night was like thick ink paint, completely swallowing up the prosperity of Kyoto. The lights in the ordinary streets and alleys have long been extinguished. Only in the direction of Tianlao on the north side of the imperial city, a single dim lamp hangs all year round, swaying in the bleak autumn wind, and the entire forbidden area is immersed in the biting cold. This is the most severe prison in the Dayin Dynasty, with three-foot-high walls and thousands of layers of iron locks. The blue bricks and stone walls are soaked in cold and wet water vapor all year round and are covered with dark green moss. There are dark blood stains on the ground that have persisted for many years. Everyone says that those who enter the Heavenly Prison will probably never see the light of day again. There is no shortage of innocent souls here, and there is no shortage of sinister plots hidden under the law.
At three quarters of the night, everything was silent. Only the harsh sound of iron chains dragging the ground could be heard from the depths of the prison from time to time, mixed with the low scolding of the jailer, echoing back and forth in the empty stone corridor. The heavy black iron prison door was slowly pushed open, and the squeaking sound of rusty iron tore through the dead silence. Several figures in black outfits and silver-patterned masks walked slowly in through the cold night. Their clothes are embroidered with dark patterns and shadows, and their auras are cold and killing. They are the most mysterious and feared dead warriors of the Shadow Alliance in the world.
The man they held in the middle was named Tie Xunliu.
At this moment, Tie Xunliu has long lost the valiant demeanor of the former knight-errant. His hands were tightly locked by heavy dark iron shackles, and the flesh on his wrists was so worn by the cold iron hoop that it oozed blood. Dark red blood traces snaked down his forearms, dripping onto the cold bluestone floor, and scattered blood splashes. His legs were also tied with heavy iron chains, which made a harsh sound with every step he took. The heavy shackles almost bent his back. The plain cloth he wore was already stained by dust and blood, and his hair was messy and hanging down, covering his eyebrows. Only his tight jawline showed his unbroken pride.
No one knew that this charlatan, who had always been a chivalrous person, traveled around the world and never got involved in court disputes, would be dragged into this monstrous disaster out of thin air tonight. No one knew that this imprisonment and late-night interrogation was a carefully planned frame-up from beginning to end.
Half an hour ago, the old lanes of Nancheng were still dimly lit. At the invitation of an old friend, Tie Xunliu went to the old house in the alley to retrieve an old thing that he had stored in his early years. He has been upright and upright throughout his life, and has always disdained the intrigues of the court. He has never been involved in the disputes in the world. He only walks around the world based on his heart, helping the weak and the poor. However, it is precisely because of this idle and unruly temperament that he has become the perfect scapegoat in the game between the court forces and the Shadow Alliance.
The Shadow Alliance has been dormant in the shadows of the court for many years, secretly cultivating power and colluding with traitors. Recently, an old case of liaison with an enemy country and interception of a border envoy was almost exposed many years ago. The tragedy that year had a wide range of implications. More than a dozen border secret agents were killed, all the secret reports were stolen, and the court has been pursuing it for several years without any clues. It has long been an unsolved case. In order to cover up the evidence of the core person's crime, the top leaders of the Shadow League made a plan overnight to find a helpless person with few connections and who had briefly appeared in the area where the crime occurred to bear all the blame.
A few years ago, Tie Xunliu happened to pass through the small border town where the crime occurred and stayed for more than half a day. Such an insignificant past, which was originally a trace of ordinary travel, was deliberately dug out and magnified by the Shadow Alliance, becoming the only evidence to frame him.
In the old alley, more than a hundred dead soldiers of the Shadow Alliance suddenly surrounded them, and they launched their killing moves without leaving any room for chance. Although Tie Xunliu was extremely skilled and had a long sword across the rivers and lakes, he rarely encountered an opponent. However, the opponent was outnumbered, his moves were sinister, and each of them was fearless of death. After fighting for hundreds of moves, he was accidentally plotted by Mi Yan, his meridians, his meridians were stagnant, and his internal strength collapsed. He was finally outnumbered and subdued. There was no official arrest document, no charges in court, and not even a word of public guilt. He was detained by the Shadow Alliance with a secret order and quietly sent to this prison.
Inside the Tianlao, the cold air was biting, far worse than the late autumn night wind. The air is filled with thorns of blood, mold, rot and rust all year round.Nose smell, heavy and turbid air envelopes the surrounding areas, making people feel stagnant and depressed when breathing. The cells on both sides are stacked on top of each other and are endlessly deep. The iron bars are rusty and mottled. The prison is pitch black. You can faintly hear the low whimpering of the prisoners, the soft sound of the iron chains shaking, and the occasional tiny sound of mice scurrying across the ground, making it even more eerie and terrifying. Cold water vapor continuously seeped out from the gaps in the stone wall, dripping slowly along the wall and hitting the bluestone, making a monotonous and silent ticking sound, which touched the heartstrings.
The dead soldiers of the Shadow Alliance walked neatly and silently, using only hand gestures to guide the way, dragging Tie Xunliu all the way to the secret interrogation chamber in the deepest part of the prison. This is a forbidden place in the forbidden land of heaven. It is not a place for regular prison trials. It is not regulated by Dali Temple and the Ministry of Punishment. It is specially used for secret trials of felons and secret trials of unjust cases. Countless unjust cases that no one knows about are quietly ended here.
In the center of the torture chamber stands a dark torture pillar. The column is covered with old marks of varying depths, all of which are blood marks and scratches left by years of interrogation. The ground is paved with thick bluestone, which has been soaked with countless blood, depositing a dark black and red color that cannot be washed away. There were only two thick butter candles lit in the room. The candlelight flickered dimly, and the light flickered, pulling the figure into a twisted and narrow shape, casting it on the mottled stone wall, like a ghost wandering around. The sound of wind rustled through the cracks in the window lattice, making the entire execution room even more deadly and gloomy.
Tie Xunliu was severely pushed to the ground by the dead soldier. His knees hit the cold and hard bluestone, and severe pain spread all over his body instantly. The black iron shackles were tightly locked on the clasp of the torture post, and the limbs were completely fixed, making it impossible to move. The rough iron chain was deeply embedded in the flesh, and the originally ulcerated wound was pulled and torn. Warm blood continued to seep out, dripping slowly along the iron chain, hitting the ground and forming a small blood puddle. The coldness and severe pain were intertwined, gnawing at his muscles and bones.
He slowly raised his head, and his eyes under the messy hair were still clear and sharp. There was no trace of cowardice or fear, only coldness and confusion. He has been magnanimous for most of his life and has no qualms about heaven and earth. He has never done anything to cause harm to the common people or harm the world. He has never been involved in court intrigues or border secrets. He will never be reconciled to being detained for no reason or convicted for no reason.
"Why are you detaining me?" Tie Xunliu's voice was hoarse and dry, but every word was sonorous, penetrating the deathly silence of the execution room. "I, Tie Xunliu, walk around the rivers and lakes, looking up to me without any shame. I have not violated the laws of the country, and have not harmed the people. You have no evidence to arrest your beloved, so you are not afraid of offending the law and getting burned?"
No one answered.
The leader of the Shadow Alliance, standing in the middle of the execution room, slowly raised his hand and took off his silver-patterned mask. The man's face was thin and stern, with a sinister look on his face. He was Shen Hanzhou, the core member of the Shadow Alliance who was in charge of secret executions and was responsible for frame-ups and exterminations. He has always been ruthless in his methods and meticulous in his thinking. He has dealt with countless unjust cases, never missed a case, and never survived.
Shen Hanzhou walked slowly to Tie Xunliu, lowered his eyes and looked down at the man who was kneeling in embarrassment, covered in scars but with unbroken pride, and the corners of his lips curled up with a cold and sarcastic arc. He leaned forward and lightly brushed the dried blood stains on the torture pillar with his fingertips. His tone was calm, but with a chill to the bone: "Worthy of heaven and earth? Tie Xunliu, in this heavenly prison, the most useless thing is the word "clear of guilt."
He raised his hand and waved lightly, and the two shadow warriors behind him immediately stepped forward and slapped a stack of yellowed and old files on the interrogation table next to them. The cover of the dossier is old and damaged, the corners are frayed and turned white, and there are traces of official seals from the early years. It seems to be neat and rigorous, but inside it has been tampered with and replaced, and every word is carefully forged evidence of crime.
"In the tenth year of the Apocalypse, at the end of autumn, the wild geese in the western border returned to the pass." Shen Hanzhou stood with his hands behind his back, his voice was cold and low, slowly echoing in the empty torture room, "The border envoy was passing through the border with important military aircraft. That night, all members were attacked. All thirteen emissaries were killed, all the top-secret military information of the imperial court was stolen, the border defenses were almost destroyed, and countless soldiers died in vain. The case has been pending for five years, and the investigation by the government and the public has failed. Today, the real murderer was finally found. "
Tie Xunliu's pupils suddenly shrank and his heart sank.He had already heard about the interception and murder case of the secret envoy at Yanhui Pass. At that time, the case shocked both the government and the public. The late emperor was furious and ordered a nationwide investigation. However, there was no trace of the murderer and it was eventually reduced to an unsolved case. He clearly remembered that at the end of the autumn of the 22nd year of Yong'an, he did pass through Yanhui Pass. At that time, it just happened to be an autumn rain. He stayed in a small town outside the pass for two days to take shelter from the rain. He never went near the border military camp, and he never came into contact with any secret envoys or important military aircraft. On such an ordinary journey, he was suddenly charged with the heinous charges of murder, interception of secrets, and collaboration with the enemy and treason.
"That's nonsense." Tie Xunliu refuted sternly, with a cold look in his eyes. "When I passed through Yanhui Pass, I was just passing by to take shelter from the rain. I kept to myself the whole time. I never participated in any fights, and I never came into contact with military secrets. There is no evidence in the case that has been pending for five years, so why should I be framed out of thin air?"
When Shen Hanzhou heard this, he didn't get angry but smiled. His smile was cold and bone-chilling, without any warmth at all. He raised his hand to open the case file, and his fingertips ran across the forged records and evidence list. The words were clear and heartbreaking: "Framing something out of thin air? Tie Xunliu, you are too naive."
"First, among all the people who entered and exited Yanhui Pass at that time, you were the only one with unknown identity, no official status, free movement, and you stayed in the pass on the day of the incident. The timing is completely consistent."
"Secondly, the sword marks left at the scene of the fight have been compared by the court craftsmen and are highly consistent with the Liuyun sword technique you are used to. There are only a few people in the world who can use this sword technique."
"Thirdly, in the last message left by the enemy who escaped that year, he mentioned that a civilian swordsman assisted him in intercepting the emissary and stealing military information. His appearance and appearance are exactly the same as yours."
The three so-called incriminating evidences are layer by layer and interlocking. They seem to be irrefutable and irrefutable, but in fact, all of them are deliberately forged and pieced together to create an illusion. Sword marks can be imitated, confessions can be fabricated, and physical appearance can be deliberately traced. All traces have been carefully polished by the Shadow Alliance, erasing all flaws, just to nail Tie Xunliu to the position of the sinner.
Tie Xunliu looked at the stack of carefully forged files and felt a chill in his heart, which was as cold as bone. He finally saw clearly that this was not an ordinary interrogation at all, but a premeditated frame-up. The Shadow Alliance did not want their old crimes to be exposed, so they chose him as a scapegoat. They used an old case that had been dusty for five years to completely drag him into the abyss of eternal destruction.
"They are all forgeries." Tie Xunliu clenched his teeth, and his voice was as cold as iron, "Although I have learned the Liuyun sword technique, there are many imitators in the world, so it is not enough. The enemy country made a detailed deathbed confession without any corroboration, which is pure fabrication. Convicting a person of death based on a coincidence of whereabouts alone, is this what you call ironclad evidence?"
Shen Hanzhou watched him struggling and arguing indifferently, his expression unmoved, his eyes only filled with indifference and coldness: "What we said in this heavenly prison is the ironclad proof."
After the words fell, he raised his hand and slammed the table, and said solemnly: "The night trial begins. If you refuse to confess, you will use torture to extract a confession."
In the execution room, the atmosphere suddenly became solemn. The shadow soldiers on both sides immediately stepped forward and brought in all kinds of rusty torture instruments. Iron clamps, leather whips, nail boards, and fire brands were neatly arranged. The cold metal glowed with a cold light under the dim candlelight, making the entire torture chamber look like a purgatory on earth. The bloody smell accumulated over the years hit his face, making him almost suffocate.
The first whip fell, and the thick salt-soaked whip hit Tie Xunliu's back hard. The fabric tore instantly, the skin and flesh burst open, and the burning pain instantly swept through the whole body. The ferocious blood marks immediately appeared, scarlet and dazzling, and the blood slowly flowed along the texture of the back, soaking into the clothes.
The sharp pain was bone-piercing, and Tie Xunliu's body trembled violently. Cold sweat suddenly appeared on his forehead, and his knuckles turned white from clenching hard. But he always gritted his teeth and never let out a cry of pain. Even though his straight back was bound by shackles and whipped with whips, he still refused to bend even half an inch.
"Do you want to move?" Shen Hanzhou asked in a deep voice, his tone cold and oppressive.
Tie Xunliu raised his eyes, his eyes were as sharp as a knife, he looked directly at the ruthless person in front of him, and his words were sonorous: "No guilt can be punished!"
